underlines.text: fatigued by the exercise of the morning

reference.text: Elizabeth longed to explore its windings; but when they had crossed the bridge, and perceived their distance from the house, Mrs. Gardiner, who was not a great walker, could go no farther, and thought only of returning to the carriage as quickly as possible.

reference.text: She longed to inquire of the housekeeper whether her master were really absent, but had not courage for it.
